subject: Comprehensive City Charter Revision
overview: The council advanced a major school infrastructure loan and health care protection ordinances, while amending and referring the Mayor’s revised City Charter draft to a special meeting. It also passed a resolution condemning a recent ICE detention and denied the sale of city-owned parcels on McCormick Avenue.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the minutes of March 25, 2025, and reports from the Planning, Public Health, and Resident Services committees regarding zoning, health care ordinances, and budget surveys.

items.title: 2025 Municipal Election Calendar
items.summary: Approved the 2025 municipal election calendar, setting the preliminary election for September 16 and the general election for November 4.

items.title: School HVAC and Infrastructure Loan Order
items.summary: Approved for first reading a $25,775,000 loan order for boiler replacements, cooling systems, and roof repairs at the McGlynn and Andrews schools.

items.title: Winthrop Street Garden Pergola Funding
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $11,000 from Community Preservation Act funds for the installation of a pergola at the Winthrop Street Gardens.

items.title: Public Hearing: 282 Mystic Ave Signage
items.summary: Continued a public hearing to April 29 regarding a petition by Clear Channel to upgrade digital screens and reduce permit fees at 282 Mystic Ave.

items.title: Gender-Affirming and Reproductive Health Care Ordinance
items.summary: Approved for first reading an ordinance to protect health care providers and seekers from out-of-state legal interference and ensure fair access to medical information.

items.title: Resolution on Rumeysa Ozturk Detention
items.summary: Approved a resolution condemning the ICE detention of Tufts student Rumeysa Ozturk as a violation of constitutional rights and calling for her immediate release.

items.title: Know Your Rights Information Distribution
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the city to create and distribute multi-lingual informational materials regarding legal rights during interactions with law enforcement and immigration officials.

items.title: City Charter Revision Draft
items.summary: Referred the Mayor's revised charter draft to a special meeting on April 15 after adopting amendments to remove the Mayor from the School Committee and modify future charter review composition.

items.title: Vacant Building Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a resolution to establish a vacant commercial storefront registry and beautification requirements to the Committee on Administration and Finance.

items.title: Autism Spectrum Disorder Care Model
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging state health officials to adopt a three-tier delivery model for autism care to expand the availability of practitioners and reduce waitlists.

items.title: Capen Park Tree Removal Report
items.summary: Placed on file a report stating that tree removals at Capen Park were necessitated by basketball court construction and will be mitigated with new plantings.

items.title: Resolution for Peace and Unity
items.summary: Tabled a resolution concerning the Israel-Palestine conflict following debate regarding its characterization of the ongoing violence and its impact on community dialogue.

items.title: Conveyance of McCormick Avenue Parcels
items.summary: The motion to approve the sale of city-owned land on McCormick Avenue failed, with several councilors arguing against the sale of public land to fund a housing nexus study.
